calculation_handling.description: Minimum 2.0 m above-ground separation between facing main walls of the same townhouse or apartment building (major-street lot) where neither wall has openings to dwelling units.
calculation_handling.gaps: The opening arms (no openings / openings in one wall / openings in each wall) have no vocab.lot_condition token, so the three minimums are keyed on the major-street condition only; where all apply the largest minimum binds (conservative).

units.disclosure: Separation between facing walls depends on window and door openings, which we do not know; this limit is not checked.

calculation_handling.description: Minimum 5.5 m separation between facing main walls of the same building where one of the walls has no openings to dwelling units.
calculation_handling.gaps: The opening arms (no openings / openings in one wall / openings in each wall) have no vocab.lot_condition token, so the three minimums are keyed on the major-street condition only; where all apply the largest minimum binds (conservative).

calculation_handling.gaps: The opening arms (no openings / openings in one wall / openings in each wall) have no vocab.lot_condition token, so the three minimums are keyed on the major-street condition only; where all apply the largest minimum binds (conservative).

calculation_handling.description: Minimum 5.5 m separation between main walls of two or more townhouses or apartment buildings on the same major-street lot where one or more of the walls has no openings to dwelling units.
calculation_handling.gaps: The opening arms (no openings / openings in one wall / openings in each wall) have no vocab.lot_condition token, so the three minimums are keyed on the major-street condition only; where all apply the largest minimum binds (conservative).

calculation_handling.description: Minimum 11.0 m separation between main walls of buildings on the same major-street lot where each wall has an opening to a dwelling unit.
calculation_handling.gaps: The opening arms (no openings / openings in one wall / openings in each wall) have no vocab.lot_condition token, so the three minimums are keyed on the major-street condition only; where all apply the largest minimum binds (conservative).

10.20.40.80(1).explanation: For a townhouse or apartment building on a major-street lot, facing walls of the same building must be at least 2.0 m apart with no unit openings, 5.5 m if only one wall has openings, and 11.0 m if both do.

10.20.40.80(2).explanation: Where two or more townhouse or apartment buildings share a major-street lot, their walls must be at least 5.5 m apart if a wall has no unit openings, or 11.0 m if each wall has openings.
